name: hcapp_getPaymentReport
description: Returns a combined payment report for an event as a single rowset. Four segments are UNION'd and distinguished by paymentType: (1) actual payment rows (paymentType 2–8, including non-cancelled); (2) virtual 'not paid' rows for attendees without a payment (paymentType=1); (3) aggregate summary rows per payment type with paymentType+100 offset (e.g. Cash total → paymentType=103); (4) a standalone count row for unpaid attendees (paymentType=101, always emitted when @eventId is provided). Also returns each unpaid attendee's kennel credit balance (creditRemaining) so the WankerBanker can apply offsets. Read SP — no success envelope.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to ValidateAppAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived cryptographic token validated against DeviceSecret by ValidateAppAuth.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event to report on. Defaults to NULL. The null-UUID '00000000-...' is also normalised to NULL on entry. When NULL all UNION segments return empty (guarded by WHERE @eventId IS NOT NULL).

rowsets.name: AuthError
rowsets.description: Returned when ValidateAppAuth fails (bad token, device not found, etc.). Mutually exclusive with PaymentReport rowset.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: HC.ErrorLog GUID for this error instance.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error classification code. 11=auth failure.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Specific error code within the errorType.

columns.name: errorTitle
columns.description: Short error title for display.

columns.name: errorUserMessage
columns.description: User-facing error message.

columns.name: errorProc
columns.description: SP name via OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID).

rowsets.name: PaymentReport
rowsets.description: UNION of 4 segments — caller must inspect paymentType to classify each row. paymentType 2–8: real payment rows (non-cancelled). paymentType 1: synthetic 'not paid' row per attendee lacking a payment. paymentType 101+: aggregate summary rows (original paymentType + 100); paymentType 101 also serves as the 'not paid' count row. Ordered by paidBy ascending. Mutually exclusive with AuthError rowset.

columns.name: hasherEventMapId
columns.description: HasherEventMap.id for payment and not-paid rows. Fixed null-UUID '00000000-...' for aggregate summary rows.

columns.name: userIdWhoPaid
columns.description: Hasher.id of the attendee who paid (or should pay). Fixed null-UUID '00000000-...' for aggregate rows.

columns.name: paymentId
columns.description: Payment.id. NULL for not-paid rows and aggregate summary rows.

columns.name: paidBy
columns.description: Display name of the payer. Virgin/visitor rows are suffixed with ' (Virgin)' or ' (Visitor)'. Literal 'not used' for aggregate summary rows.

columns.name: paidTo
columns.description: Display name of the payment receiver (PaymentProcessedBy_userId). '<user deleted>' if that Hasher no longer exists. Literal 'none' for not-paid and aggregate rows.

columns.name: cancelledBy
columns.description: Display name of the user who cancelled the payment. NULL for non-cancelled, not-paid, and aggregate rows.

columns.name: creditAmount
columns.description: Amount credited (paid). 0 for not-paid rows. SUM(CreditAmount) for aggregate rows.

columns.name: debitAmount
columns.description: Amount debited (event price owed). For not-paid rows: the applicable event price (member or non-member rate). SUM(DebitAmount) for aggregate rows.

columns.name: paymentType
columns.description: Row category discriminator. 1=not paid (synthetic). 2=Free. 3=Cash. 4=Bank Transfer. 5=Cash (other). 6=Hash Credit. 7=Bank Transfer (other). 8=Hash Credit (other). 101+=aggregate summary rows (original paymentType + 100); 101 is also the standalone not-paid count row.

columns.name: paymentDate
columns.description: Payment.PaidDate. NULL for not-paid and aggregate rows.

columns.name: cancelledDate
columns.description: Payment.CancelledDate. NULL for non-cancelled, not-paid, and aggregate rows.

columns.name: paymentReference
columns.description: Payment.PaymentReference for real payment rows. For aggregate rows: CAST count of payments in that type as NVARCHAR(20), or @hashersNotPaidCount for the paymentType=101 row. NULL for not-paid rows.

columns.name: notes
columns.description: Payment.Notes. NULL for not-paid and aggregate rows.

columns.name: creditRemaining
columns.description: For not-paid rows: the attendee's total kennel credit balance (SUM of non-cancelled Payment.CreditAmount minus DebitAmount). Sourced from Payment.CreditAvailable for real payment rows. 0 for aggregate rows.

columns.name: currencySymbol
columns.description: Currency symbol from Country table. Empty string '' for aggregate rows.

columns.name: digitsAfterDecimal
columns.description: Currency decimal places from Country.DigitsAfterDecimal. 0 for aggregate rows.

columns.name: productType
columns.description: 1=event, 2=membership, 3=haberdashery. LAST column by design — the Excel endpoint reads earlier columns by ordinal. Summary rows (paymentType>100) are now grouped by paymentType AND productType. Added 1.1.0; not-paid detection also scoped to run payments.

codeSmells.issue: paymentType+100 sentinel — mixed data and metadata in a single column
codeSmells.detail: Aggregate summary rows are distinguished by paymentType = originalType + 100 (e.g. Cash → 103, not-paid count → 101). Callers must branch on paymentType >= 101 to detect aggregate rows. This encodes row category into a value column, making the schema ambiguous and fragile if new payment types approach 100.

codeSmells.issue: Part 3 and Part 4 overlap on paymentType=101 — duplicate not-paid count rows
codeSmells.detail: Part 3 (aggregate per payment type) includes a GROUP BY COALESCE(pay.PaymentType,1)+100 that can produce a paymentType=101 row for attendees whose HEM row has no payment at all (LEFT JOIN produces NULL PaymentType → COALESCE gives 1 → +100 = 101). Part 4 then always emits its own paymentType=101 row when @eventId IS NOT NULL. The two rows can coexist in the result with the same paymentType, confusing callers. The @hashersNotPaidCount variable is computed before Part 3 runs but Parts 3 and 4 emit separate rows; callers must be aware.

codeSmells.issue: No TRY/CATCH block — unhandled runtime errors propagate raw to caller
codeSmells.detail: The SP has no TRY/CATCH wrapper. Any runtime error (e.g. a missing kennel or country row, temp table failure) will propagate as a raw SQL error rather than the structured HC6 error rowset, breaking client error handling assumptions.

codeSmells.issue: Credit balance query in #creditTemp aggregates across all kennels
codeSmells.detail: The LEFT OUTER JOIN on HC.Payment for credit balance (line 112) has no KennelId filter — it sums credit across all kennels for the user. This may overstate available credit if the user has credits in unrelated kennels. Intent may be deliberate (global wallet) but it is undocumented.

codeSmells.issue: Part 1 filters cancelled payments but Part 3 may include cancelled HEM rows
codeSmells.detail: Part 1 (real payment rows) filters WHERE pay.CancelledBy_UserId IS NULL. Part 3 (aggregates) also filters pay.CancelledBy_UserId IS NULL. However, the LEFT JOIN in Part 3 joins on HasherEventMap rows (not filtered by CancelledBy), meaning aggregate sums correctly exclude cancelled payments, but the GROUP BY produces one row per non-cancelled payment type only — consistent with intent.

codeSmells.issue: paymentDate and cancelledDate returned as DATETIMEOFFSET — HC5 cast to DATETIME (timezone stripped)
codeSmells.detail: HC5 cast PaidDate and CancelledDate to DATETIME, losing timezone offset. HC6 returns the raw DATETIMEOFFSET(7) columns directly from the Payment table, which is correct but is a wire-format change callers must handle.

breakingChanges: isMember is now computed dynamically from HasherKennelMap.MembershipExpirationDate compared to GETDATE() rather than a stored IsMember flag. Event price applied to not-paid rows may differ from HC5 in edge cases where the stored flag was stale.

@eventId default sentinel changed from '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' to NULL. The null-UUID is still accepted and normalised to NULL internally, so existing callers sending the null-UUID are unaffected.
paymentDate and cancelledDate are now returned as DATETIMEOFFSET(7) instead of DATETIME — timezone offset is preserved. Callers that expected DATETIME must be updated.

Auth is now performed by HC6.ValidateAppAuth (SP number 42) instead of the HC5 inline auth pattern. Error rowset columns are errorId, errorType, errorCode, errorTitle, errorUserMessage, errorProc — the HC5 error rowset did not include errorCode.
